mapper.select: SELECT t.user_name as userName, t.sex, t.age, t.avatar, t.room_no as roomNo, t.room_id as roomId, t.is_room as isRoom, t.on_line as onLine, g.game_name as gameName, o.*, (select ifnull(avg(score), 0) from taking_commnt where order_taking_id = o.id) as commentScore, (select count(*) from orders where order_taking_id = o.id and `state` = 2) as ordersCount, g.game_img as gameImg, (st_distance(point(o.longitude, o.latitude), point(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) * 111195) as distance FROM order_taking o LEFT JOIN game g ON o.game_id = g.id LEFT JOIN tb_user t ON t.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.STATUS = 0 and o.isdelete=0 and t.user_id is not null order by onLine=1 desc,t.create_time desc limit 3

SELECT t.avatar, t.age, t.sex, t.on_line as onLine, t.room_no as roomNo, t.room_id as roomId, t.is_room as isRoom, t.user_name as userName, g.game_name as gameName, g.game_img as gameImg, o.*, (select ifnull(avg(score), 0) from taking_commnt where order_taking_id = o.id) as commentScore, (select count(*) from orders where order_taking_id = o.id and `state` = 2) as ordersCount, (st_distance(point(o.longitude, o.latitude), point(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) * 111195) as distance FROM order_taking o LEFT JOIN game g ON o.game_id = g.id LEFT JOIN tb_user t ON t.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.STATUS = 0 and o.isdelete=0 and t.user_id is not null order by onLine=1 desc,t.create_time desc

SELECT t.avatar, t.user_name as userName, t.on_line as onLine, t.room_no as roomNo, t.room_id as roomId, t.is_room as isRoom, g.game_name as gameName, g.game_img as gameImg, t.sex, t.age, (select ifnull(avg(score), 0) from taking_commnt where order_taking_id = o.id) as commentScore, (select count(*) from orders where order_taking_id = o.id and `state` = 2) as ordersCount, o.*, (st_distance(point(o.longitude, o.latitude), point(#{longitude}, #{latitude})) * 111195) as distance FROM order_taking o LEFT JOIN game g ON o.game_id = g.id LEFT JOIN tb_user t ON t.user_id = o.user_id WHERE o.id = #{id}
